name: Garlic Parmesan Wings
instructions: Pat wings very dry. Toss with baking powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Place on a wire rack over a baking sheet. Refrigerate uncovered 1 hour or overnight.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Bake wings 40-45 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy.
Meanwhile, cook garlic in butter over medium heat 2 minutes until fragrant.
Toss hot wings in garlic butter. Add parmesan and toss again to coat.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free butter and skip parmesan.

notes: Baking powder and drying the wings overnight is the secret to oven-crispy skin.
